accuracy: Detailed artist reconstruction of Samidare, a Shiratsuyu-class destroyer, not surveyed engineering geometry. Source hull is uniformly scaled to 110 m overall, preserving artist proportions and paint waterline; fittings can extend beyond the hull length and historical beam. The exact armament/refit date must be checked visually before campaign use. This vessel is not a Fubuki or Hatsuharu substitute. Native visual review is required before campaign activation.
axes: right-handed: X bow-positive; Y up; Z transverse
author: everlasting17th
sourceRevision: Pinned public Objaverse snapshot; may differ from the current Sketchfab revision
geometrySource: Artist-authored licensed asset; no voxel or generated recognition geometry
modifications: WNT1922 baked static node hierarchy and metre scale, centered the hull, oriented bow +X and up +Y, merged primitives by material without mesh simplification, retained every embedded image byte and all artist UVs, assigned unused planar UVs to untextured rigging, normalized vertex normals, removed Float32-degenerate faces and orientation-unstable microscopic slivers, and repaired normals-disagreeing winding. Native centimetre/int16 precision is checked explicitly; only unstable slivers within eight coordinate ULPs can be discarded. Counts below identify these repairs.

nativePrecision.rule: Drop only collapsed faces or winding-unstable slivers whose altitude is at most eight Float32 position ULPs; robust source winding is corrected, not discarded.
